about.intro: RigReady was born from a simple question: can it run it? A free platform that analyzes your hardware and tells you exactly what you can play — and at what quality.

step1.title: Enter your specs
step1.body: CPU, GPU, RAM — desktop or laptop. No sign-up, no account.

step2.title: Pick a game
step2.body: Search any title from Steam's full catalog, right from the app.

step3.title: Get your verdict
step3.body: Ultra, High, or Potato. With bottleneck analysis and comparative scores.

community.head: Community first
community.body: Hardware data is contributed and validated by the gamer community.

noBs.head: No BS
noBs.body: No forced sign-up, no paywalls. The evaluator is free forever.

realData.head: Real data
realData.body: We plug into Steam's API and PassMark's verified benchmark databases.

spanishFirst.head: Spanish-first
spanishFirst.body: Designed with Latin American and Spanish gamers in mind.
